query: On RTX 5090 (RunPod, torch 2.8.0+cu128), enabling any Sage Attention mode gives ~10.5s/image identical to disabled; sageattn_qk_int8_pv_fp16_triton produces black images. Suspected incompatible prebuilt wheels/old torch for Blackwell.

desired.outcome: Community diagnosis: xformers incompatible with installed torch; recommend torch built for CUDA 13 (2.9.1+), compile xformers and SageAttention from source, update NVIDIA driver to 580+. Not OP-confirmed in thread.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
